cpu.description:
The requested number of CPUs. Note that this could refer to virtual CPUs.
This value should be less than or equal to cpuLimit if set.

memoryMb.description:
The requested memory size in MB.
This value should be less than or equal to memoryMbLimit if set.

diskGb.description:
The requested disk size in GB.
This value should be less than or equal to diskGbLimit if set.

gpu.description:
The number of GPUs.

Use {@link #acceleratorCount} instead.

gpuMemoryMb.description:
The GPU memory size in MB

If applicable, memory is depend on {@link HardwareAccelerator.acceleratorKind acceleratorKind}.

cpuLimit.description:
Maximum number of CPUs (physical or virtual) that each node in this {@link App.NodePool}
may consume during burst loads, subject to availability on the underlying host.

This value is an upper bound on total CPU usage (baseline cpu requests + burst capacity),
not a guaranteed allocation.

Set to null to not set a CPU limit.

memoryMbLimit.description:
Maximum memory (in MB) each node in this {@link App.NodePool} can use,
subject to availability on the underlying host.

This sets an upper bound on total memory usage (baseline request + burst capacity),
but does not guarantee allocation. Because memory cannot be easily reclaimed,
it is recommended to set {@link memoryMbLimit} equal to {@link memoryMb}.

Set to null to use {@link memoryMb} as {@link memoryMbLimit}.

diskGbLimit.description:
Maximum disk size (in GB) each node in this {@link App.NodePool} can use,
subject to availability on the underlying host.

This sets an upper bound on total disk usage (baseline request + burst capacity),
but does not guarantee allocation. Because disk cannot be easily reclaimed,
it is recommended to set {@link diskGbLimit} equal to {@link diskGb}.

Set to null to use {@link diskGb} as {@link diskGbLimit}.

instanceType.description: Cloud Provider Machine Type Name (ex: "n2d-standard-32" on gcp)

gpuVendor.description:
Name of the GPU Vendor (ex. nvidia, amd, or intel)

Use {@link #acceleratorKind} instead.

gpuKind.description:
The specific kind of GPU (ex. A100-SXM4-40GB)

Use {@link #acceleratorKind} instead.

hardwareAvailability.description: Specifies the {@link HardwareAvailability} for a given VM.

acceleratorKind.description:
The specific kind of {@link HardwareAccelerator} (ex. A100-SXM4-40GB).

This field is required if {@link #acceleratorCount} greater than 0.

computeKind.description: The identifier of the Kubernetes node pool that serves as the scheduling target for the C3 node pool.
